# Nadir

> Nadir is a 2D top-down game engine for desktop, written in Rust from the ground up by Joseph Abbott III, with no third-party crates: its own OS bindings, OpenGL renderer, ECS, collision, codecs and tools. https://jabbott.dev/Nadir/ plays the engine's sandbox game as commit {{commit_short}} draws it, recorded in CI, and lists the engine's features with how far each has come.

Key facts:

- Status: in development, {{tasks_done}} of {{tasks_total}} roadmap tasks done at commit {{commit_short}} of {{commit_date}} ({{commit_subject}})
- Language: Rust {{toolchain}}, edition 2024; {{crates}} crates in the workspace; third-party crates: {{third_party}}
- Targets: Windows 10+ and Linux (X11) on x86_64 and aarch64, and macOS 12+ (Apple Silicon and Intel). Only Linux draws so far: the Windows and macOS windows (roadmap M1.5, M1.6, still to be checked by hand) stay empty until their OpenGL contexts land (M2.6, M2.7).
- Out of scope: web and WASM, Android, iOS, consoles, 3D and networking
- License: Apache-2.0
- Source: {{repository_url}}
- Author: Joseph Abbott III, software engineer (https://jabbott.dev/resume/)

## Architecture

The page draws two views of the C4 model, which {{repository_url}}/blob/{{commit}}/diagrams/c4-architecture.md also draws, with the crates inside the game and the cook:

- System context: the game developer draws sprites in Aseprite, lays out levels in LDtk, and draws images and makes fonts in image editors and font generators, each saving into assets/. The developer runs Nadir's tools, nadir-cook, the asset cook, and xtask, the build automation, which read assets/ and write target/cooked/ and game.kpak, and writes and runs the game built on Nadir, which reads the cooked files or game.kpak and writes nadir.log. The player plays the game with keyboard and mouse, watches the demo, downloads the Linux build and downloads releases. The game opens a window and reads its events through X11 on Linux, Win32 on Windows and AppKit on macOS, and draws through OpenGL 3.3 core, through EGL on Linux. Planned: OpenGL contexts on Windows and macOS, then Metal (roadmap M2.6, M2.7, M10), the OS audio APIs (M6) and gamepads (M8). GitHub Actions runs cargo xtask, deploys this page to GitHub Pages, and publishes each tagged release: the GitHub release and apt repository, the cook's image on ghcr.io and the crates on crates.io.
- Containers: xtask, which the developer runs and GitHub Actions runs as cargo xtask ci, golden, fuzz-smoke, site and dist, runs nadir-cook to cook: it reads assets/, writes the loose files in target/cooked/, skipping jobs and files that did not change, and packs every output into target/cooked/game.kpak. The developer runs the game executable, the sandbox, and xtask builds it in release and runs it for site and dist: with the dev feature it reads the loose files, and without it the pack when it is there, else the loose files. The sandbox reads the folder assets beside its executable when there is one, as in the release files and the download, and target/cooked/ otherwise. xtask also runs nadir-bench, and writes target/dist/ and target/site/. The game writes its logs to the user's logs folder, and draws through the OS and GPU driver. Planned (M5.8): the game reloads what changed.
